name: vetgest-medical-content
description: Use when creating, editing, reviewing, or publishing VetGest pregnancy phases, care guidance, alert rules, or veterinary educational content.
---

# VetGest Medical Content Review

1. Identify species, pregnancy phase, intended audience, and evidence scope.
2. Separate educational guidance from diagnosis, treatment, and prescription.
3. State uncertainty for dates, symptoms, and expected ranges.
4. Check dog and cat differences explicitly.
5. Ensure attention and emergency content gives an appropriate veterinary-care direction.
6. Reject invasive home-obstetric instructions and unsupported clinical claims.
7. Record reviewer, review date, source, and publication status.
8. Add tests for severity, wording, and missing-review safeguards.
